faq.q: How much does Drummond Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Drummond Law Firm publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Drummond Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Drummond Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. The firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Drummond Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Drummond Law Firm publishes one office, in Las Vegas. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Drummond Law Firm?
faq.a: Drummond Law Firm names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
